dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The books from what place in Ritou now?

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Well, I mean, my job relies on creativity, so I have to learn new stuff, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: That's why I often ask friends to send me new books from overseas. If there are some impounded books over in Ritou, I will also tell them to bring them in.

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: You have to keep that whole "impounded books" business a secret for me, alright? In exchange, I'll let you read the new stuff next time.
